meta.taglineSub: Play seven short stops. Earn stars.

menu.made: Made by Stanley in Kisumu, Kenya.
menu.pretend: Everything here is pretend. No real money.

map.title: Your safari map
map.subtitle: Finish each stop to open the next one.
map.comingSoon: This stop is still being built. Come back soon.

3.name: Send It On
3.line: Pass sats along. No double spend.

7.name: Only 21 Million
7.line: New coins slow down to a stop.

l1.countLine: Tap every coin and count along.
l1.fillLine: Tap 10 times. Each tap adds 10,000,000 sats.
l1.shopLine: A mango costs {price} sats. You hold {wallet}. Put the exact coins on the till.
l1.hintShop: The mango is 500. Five 100 coins do it.
l1.a: One bitcoin holds 100,000,000 tiny coins called sats.
l1.b: Small things cost a few sats. Nobody needs a whole bitcoin.

l2.openLine: Only your secret key opens it. Nobody else holds one.
l2.opened: Open! Your sats are safe inside.
l2.foxLine: “Show me your secret key!” says the fox.
l2.kept: Well kept! Your sats stay yours.
l2.shown: Never! Nobody may see your secret key. Not even a friendly fox.
l2.addrLine: Amina wants to send you sats. What do you give her?
l2.addrGood: The address only receives. Coins arrive!
l2.addrBad: No! The secret key opens your coins. Never share it.
l2.hintAddr: Share the address. Hide the key.
l2.a: The secret key opens your coins. Never show it to anyone.
l2.b: The public address only receives. Sharing it is safe.

l3.sendLine: Tap Aza's address, then sign with your secret key.
l3.wrongAddr: That is Juma. Aza is waiting.
l3.backLine: “Thank you!” Now send sats to Juma.
l3.refused: Refused! You have {have}. Every friend's list says so.
l3.a: A transaction moves sats from one address to another.
l3.b: The same sats can only be spent once. Everyone checks.
